working: I: Br2 adds anti to trans-but-2-ene, so the product is meso-2,3-dibromobutane. In the drawn Br-anti conformation, H is anti to Me rather than to H. There is no centre of symmetry, so it shows the (±) chiral form and Statement I is incorrect. II: alkaline KMnO4 gives syn dihydroxylation of cis-but-2-ene, so the product is the meso diol. Rotating the back carbon of the drawn projection to make OH anti to OH puts H anti H and Me anti Me. That conformation is centrosymmetric, so the drawing is the meso diol and Statement II is correct.
